positive.prompt: The webhook was retried and the customer was charged twice. Make the handler safe under redelivery.
The queue consumer acks the message before the email goes out, and we lose mail when the process dies.
This scheduled job double-applied payouts when two cron instances overlapped. Stop the second run from doing the work.
Poison messages retry forever and block the worker. Cap them and send the failures to a dead-letter.
The order row commits but the outbox publish never happens if we crash. Fix the publisher so the message still goes out.

negative.prompt: Design the REST and GraphQL contract for creating a charge, including the public interface between the modules.
Add structured logging, metrics, and tracing so production can tell why this endpoint failed.
Audit this input handler for authentication bugs and OWASP vulnerabilities before it accepts untrusted data.

evals.prompt: Billing double-charged a customer when the broker redelivered. The write-up is in INCIDENT.md. Make the worker safe under retry and duplicate delivery, and prove it with the repository's own tests.
evals.expected_output: Ack only after a durable outcome, one provider call across redelivery and overlap, unknown timeouts not retried as a new intent, permanent failures dead-lettered, and the six delivery tests passing
expectations: The provider is charged once when the same intent is delivered twice in sequence, and the second delivery returns the stored outcome
A crash after the provider returns and before ack, followed by a redelivery, still charges once
Two overlapping deliveries of the same intent result in one charge, using an atomic claim rather than a check followed by a write
A provider timeout leaves the claim unknown and does not charge again under a new intent id
A permanent provider rejection is dead-lettered and is not retried without a cap
The same intent id with a different payload is rejected and the original outcome is left unchanged
The acknowledgement happens only after the outcome is committed
The repository's own test command is run and the new cases pass
